intel.title: [CISA KEV] JetBrains TeamCity - JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-63077
廠商: JetBrains
產品: TeamCity
漏洞名稱: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
說明: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-08
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: JetBrains TeamCity 存在未經授權的反序列化漏洞（CVE-2026-63077），攻擊者可透過代理輪詢協定遠端執行任意程式碼。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單，具有極高的安全風險。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
